title: Analysis providers: what is actually live — audited with real probes (PR-80)
ladderRule: A rung is claimed only when its proof fields and every lower rung's proof fields are present; proof for an unclaimed rung must live under `historical` (validated by artifacts/api-server/src/lib/analysisProviderAudit.ts).

method.healthProbes: authenticated GET /health?provider=<id> on the one configured endpoint (.env.local: BASIC_PITCH_API_URL, host never printed); unauthenticated GET /health on every *.modal.run origin recorded anywhere in services/, docs/ and artifacts/api-server/src
method.liveSmoke: one real POST per reachable provider on the PR-46 fixture through the platform's own lease surface (127.0.0.1:5012) behind an operator Cloudflare quick tunnel; the API itself was never exposed and no DB was involved

otherProbesOnTheSameWorker.note: a renderer, not an analysis provider; listed because it shares the worker

budget.basis: ≈3 min of one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB Modal CPU container (cold start + 5 health probes + 1 analyze + 2 refused DEMUCS calls) at list price; no GPU was started, nothing was deployed, nothing was trained

firstParty.note: Not providers on the ladder — in-process engines that fill the Song Model when nothing above answers. Listed so the table cannot be read as 'the platform analyses nothing'.

engines.defaultInFusion: yes — reconcileAnalysisField(tempo/key/meter) and the local structure fallback in sourceAnalyzer.ts
yes — key reconciliation, capped at 0.75 confidence, reliability 0.5
engines.benchmarked: no; PR-46 recorded one A minor on one song

summary.oneSentence: Of the fifteen named analysis providers, one answers a real request today; the rest are adapters pointing at endpoints that were torn down after 2026-09-06 or never existed, and none has ever been scored against a truth set.

liveSmoke.outputSummary: 1876 note events, MIDI pitch 26–86, provider confidence 0.4732, contractVersion 1.0, last note ends at 211.19 s of 9199873 bytes / 212.46 s
liveSmoke.costBasis: upper-bound estimate: one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB Modal CPU container, ~17 s billed for health + analyze at list price; Modal does not meter per request

transport.leaseSurface: analysisAssetServer.ts + analysisAssetLease.ts bundled verbatim, bound to 127.0.0.1:5012, exposed by an operator Cloudflare quick tunnel
transport.meaning: one served fetch of exactly 9,199,873 bytes = the fixture; the worker has no other route to this machine

liveSmoke.agreesWithPr46: yes: PR-46 recorded 1876 note events at confidence 0.473 on the same file

providers.whatWouldMoveItUp: BENCHMARKED needs a note-level truth set (onset/pitch F1 via mir_eval) on licensed audio with aligned MIDI; no such evidence file exists in docs/evidence. Fusion already consumes it by default (fuseCanonicalNotes, melody reliability 1.0), so PROMOTED would follow a benchmark automatically — the ladder is cumulative, so it is not claimed first.
notes: The only analysis provider with a live endpoint on this machine today.

A first authenticated /health hit a cold start and timed out at 60 s (probe at 2026-09-09T19:38:06.552Z); the retry answered in 741 ms, and the smoke's own pre-flight health took 2752 ms (fc-01M23V195FGS9VJGDJZFANGJMH).

On a full mix it returns every instrument's notes at once; the analyzer's ambiguity gate refuses to call that a melody, so a Song Model still shows melodyNotes 0 (PR-46). Stem-first transcription needs a separation endpoint, and none is live.

notes: Never deployed: PR-37 records that no DEMUCS_API_URL ever existed. There is no historical smoke to cite.
Preferred separation provider in code; without it the analyzer falls through to BS_ROFORMER, which is licence-blocked, so separation never runs today.
